question: The average age of 31 students of a class is 21 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 22 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total age of students = 31 × 21 = 651

New total (including teacher) = 32 × 22 = 704

Teacher’s age = 704 − 651

= 53

**∴ Answer = 53 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of students = 31

Average age = 21

New average with teacher = 22

Total persons = 32

**Formula used:**

Total = Average × Number of persons

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total age of students = 31 × 21

⇒ = 651

⇒ Total age including teacher = 32 × 22

⇒ = 704

⇒ Teacher’s age = 704 − 651

⇒ = 53

**∴ The correct answer is 53 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total sum ÷ Number of observations

Adding a New Value

New total = Old total + new value

Reverse Average Concept

New value = (New average × new count) − (Old average × old count)

Weighted Average

When groups combine, total = sum of individual totals, not average of averages.
